nodes.label: Imani's first three sessions
nodes.community_name: Trading Desk HUD and Order Ticket
nodes.rationale: Not a tutorial: a colleague who comments on what you actually do in sessions 1-3, then goes quiet.

nodes.label: Simplified options
nodes.community_name: Trading Desk HUD and Order Ticket
nodes.rationale: Calls and puts, weekly and monthly expiries, priced with simplified Black-Scholes; long-only.

nodes.label: Personal economy (wallet, draw, bonus, rent)
nodes.rationale: The $250k book is the firm's; your wallet gets a weekly draw or bonus, pays rent and bills; being broke is never game over.

nodes.label: Risk desk discipline review
nodes.rationale: Breaches (loss limit, leverage, overnight, chasing hype) cut the bonus 15%; a clean week pays x1.25.

nodes.label: Headless test runners
nodes.rationale: Node runners load the game in index.html order through one shared loader and play bots through whole careers.

nodes.label: Life beats (personal decisions)
nodes.rationale: Five personal decisions after the bell, paid from your own money, shown on later payslips and in the ending.

nodes.label: Endless mode
nodes.rationale: Random regimes and crash days with sliders; you pick win/lose conditions; local leaderboard per settings.

nodes.label: Twelve hidden anomalies
nodes.rationale: Unmarked anomalies in public information; each anomaly morning hides one wrong pixel and they change the final weekend.

nodes.label: Career mode (61 sessions, 22 endings)
nodes.rationale: 61 sessions over 13 weeks; 10 decisions reshape the market and route to one of 22 endings.

nodes.label: CASCADE stack symbol
nodes.rationale: The central symbol: a stacked-note mark that starts aligned, slips, and eventually falls as stability drops.

nodes.label: Adaptive chiptune score
nodes.rationale: WebAudio: two pulse voices, triangle bass, noise channel; layers breathe with stress and the clock.

nodes.label: Cinematics and storyboard
nodes.rationale: Cached authored 640x360 frames driven by a 61-row beat sheet; every scene is skippable.

nodes.label: Circuit breakers
nodes.rationale: Market halts at -7% and -13%, closes at -20%; single stocks halt after a sudden 10% move.

nodes.label: Deterministic replay saves
nodes.rationale: A day is reproducible from its seed, scenario and injected events, so a save stores only the clock and your book.

nodes.label: Everything-is-invented denylist test
nodes.rationale: A test fails if any printable string matches a real company, person or event.

nodes.label: Margin calls and liquidation
nodes.rationale: An alarm and countdown; if unfixed the risk desk liquidates your worst positions.

nodes.label: Unreliable phone tips
nodes.rationale: A tip resolves four ways (real, stale, reversal, false); roughly one in three pays.

nodes.label: Factor price model
nodes.rationale: price = prevClose * exp(beta*Market + Sector + Idiosyncratic), each factor anchored to a seeded Brownian bridge.

nodes.label: Desk quotas and career strikes
nodes.rationale: Daily and weekly quotas by market regime; each missed mandate is one permanent strike; the 30th ends the run.

nodes.label: Sqwak rumour network
nodes.rationale: The rumour feed: big accounts can move a stock for minutes whether true or not; every account has a hidden accuracy record.

nodes.label: Swappable storage adapter
nodes.rationale: All persistence goes through one adapter so a desktop wrapper (Tauri/Electron) can swap in a filesystem backend.

nodes.label: Stress 2.0 and panic
nodes.rationale: Stress escalates Loaded -> Tunnel -> Critical; panic attacks last under four seconds and A/S/D grounding ends them.

nodes.label: The Ledger subscription
nodes.rationale: Paid morning desk note with the day's biggest scheduled moves, built from the session's own schedule.

nodes.label: Four-act visual progression
nodes.rationale: Melt-Up (amber) -> Tremors (violet) -> Contagion (cold blue) -> Reckoning (bruised red).

nodes.label: Story residue on the desk
nodes.rationale: Choices and regulatory heat leave persistent objects on the player's desk.

nodes.label: Faded Power (visual thesis)
nodes.rationale: Present-day story in timeless pixel art; colour washed out, bright colour reserved for information and consequence.

nodes.label: Locked 32-colour palette
nodes.rationale: One palette shared by CSS and canvas art keeps the whole game looking like one machine drew it.

nodes.label: Three pixel fonts
nodes.rationale: Silkscreen for display and controls, Tiny5 for interface and story, VT323 for financial data.

nodes.label: Procedural pixel portraits
nodes.rationale: Seven principal characters drawn procedurally on a 48x48 grid inside the locked palette.
